baseline: top seven training translations conditional on shared block seed
input_law: offset-zero subset of archived 100000 generated 12-column sums, first 80000 train and last 20000 holdout before filtering
label: canonical full-width translation min(u,u XOR seed) for each corresponding pair slot
model: global per-translation Bernoulli bit likelihood with Laplace-one smoothing and conditional seed prior, top seven
score_contraction: numpy.einsum optimize=False; validated against v1 matrix product on finite scores
